query:
SELECT slug, status FROM blog_posts WHERE slug IN (
  'silent-gum-disease','denied-claims','misleading-insurance','missing-teeth','cracked-tooth',
  'bad-breath','stained-teeth','teeth-grinding','wisdom-teeth-confusion','tooth-sensitivity',
  'white-spots-on-teeth','undetected-cavities','communication-gap','preventive-care-gap',
  'overtreatment-concerns','fear-of-dentist','rushed-decisions','unclear-diagnoses',
  'mouth-ulcer-not-healing','jaw-pain-tmj','insurance-limitations','black-line-on-tooth',
  'gum-boil','loose-tooth-adults','filling-feels-high-pain-biting','tooth-hurts-cold-water',
  'gums-hurt-when-flossing','teeth-grinding-bruxism','canker-sore-vs-cold-sore',

  'cosmetic-vs-necessary','pre-authorization','waiting-periods','in-network-confusion'
) ORDER BY slug;
